{"file_path":"src/funding-adapters/PrefundedAdapter.sol","creation_status":"success","source_code":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport {FundingAdapter} from \"./FundingAdapter.sol\";\n\nimport {AccessControl} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeTransferERC20} from \"across-contracts/libraries/SafeTransferERC20.sol\";\n\n/// @title PrefundedAdapter\n/// @notice External per-witness prefunding ledger consumed as an Executor funding adapter.\n///         Depositors call `store` to credit a `(witness, token)` pair; later, a path-committed\n///         `ADAPTER_CALL` releases the credit for the live stepId witness to the committed\n///         recipient. The witness is opaque to this contract; the `FundingAdapter` base reads it\n///         from the Gateway's live execution context.\n///\n///         Delivery follows the funding-adapter shape (\"deliver what arrived, bounded below\"):\n///         the committed input pins `(token, minAmount, recipient)` and the adapter releases the\n///         entire stored credit — accumulated across any number of `store` calls — requiring it\n///         to be at least `minAmount`. Surplus over `minAmount` goes to the committed recipient,\n///         so a loose floor is only safe in sealed flows (see `docs/FUNDING_ADAPTERS.md`).\n///         Replay protection is the ledger decrement itself.\ncontract PrefundedAdapter is FundingAdapter, AccessControl, SafeTransferERC20 {\n    // Restricted to exclude `safeTransfer`: ERC20 transfers out of the adapter must go\n    // through the overridable `_safeTransfer` hook (see `SafeTransferERC20`), so chain\n    // variants (e.g. Tron) can swap the transfer semantics in one place.\n    using {SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom} for IERC20;\n\n    bytes32 public constant ADMIN_REFUND_FACILITATOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"ADMIN_REFUND_FACILITATOR_ROLE\");\n\n    mapping(bytes32 witness => mapping(address token => uint256 amount)) public storedFunding;\n\n    error PrefundingBelowMinimum(bytes32 witness, address token, uint256 minAmount, uint256 amount);\n    error NativeTransferFailed();\n\n    event PrefundingStored(bytes32 indexed witness, address token, uint256 amount);\n    event PrefundedFunding(bytes32 indexed witness, address token, uint256 amount, address recipient);\n    event RefundAdmin(bytes32 indexed witness, address token, uint256 amount, address recipient);\n\n    constructor(address gateway_, address admin) FundingAdapter(gateway_) {\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, admin);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Direct prefunding from `msg.sender` via ERC20 approval, optionally\n    ///         topped up with native ETH from `msg.value` (credited under `address(0)`).\n    function store(bytes32 witness, address token, uint256 amount) external payable {\n        if (amount > 0) {\n            IERC20(token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n            storedFunding[witness][token] += amount;\n            emit PrefundingStored(witness, token, amount);\n        }\n\n        if (msg.value > 0) {\n            storedFunding[witness][address(0)] += msg.value;\n            emit PrefundingStored(witness, address(0), msg.value);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev `input` shape: `abi.encode(address token, uint256 minAmount, address recipient)` —\n    ///      the path-committed acceptance bounds. `jitData` is unused: everything the delivery\n    ///      needs is either committed or already on the ledger.\n    function _deliver(bytes calldata input, bytes calldata, bytes32 witness) internal override {\n        (address token, uint256 minAmount, address recipient) = abi.decode(input, (address, uint256, address));\n\n        uint256 amount = storedFunding[witness][token];\n        if (amount < minAmount) revert PrefundingBelowMinimum(witness, token, minAmount, amount);\n\n        storedFunding[witness][token] = 0;\n\n        _transfer(token, recipient, amount);\n        emit PrefundedFunding(witness, token, amount, recipient);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Rescue tokens credited to a witness.\n    function refundAdmin(bytes32 witness, address[] calldata tokens, address recipient)\n        external\n        onlyRole(ADMIN_REFUND_FACILITATOR_ROLE)\n    {\n        for (uint256 i; i < tokens.length; ++i) {\n            address token = tokens[i];\n\n            uint256 amount = storedFunding[witness][token];\n            if (amount == 0) continue;\n\n            storedFunding[witness][token] = 0;\n            _transfer(token, recipient, amount);\n            emit RefundAdmin(witness, token, amount, recipient);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev `address(0)` means native ETH.\n    function _transfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) private {\n        if (token == address(0)) {\n            (bool ok,) = to.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n            if (!ok) revert NativeTransferFailed();\n        } else {\n            _safeTransfer(token, to, amount);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","deployed_bytecode":"","optimization_enabled":true,"verified_twin_address_hash":null,"is_verified":true,"compiler_settings":{"evmVersion":"prague","libraries":{},"metadata":{"appendCBOR":false,"bytecodeHash":"none"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":2000000},"remappings":[":@across-contracts/=lib/across-contracts/contracts/",":@across-protocol/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@across-protocol/",":@ensdomains/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@ensdomains/",":@eth-optimism/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@eth-optimism/",":@gnosis.pm/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@gnosis.pm/",":@maticnetwork/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@maticnetwork/",":@matterlabs/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@matterlabs/",":@openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable/=lib/openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable/contracts/",":@openzeppelin/contracts/=lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/",":@scroll-tech/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@scroll-tech/",":@sp1-contracts/=lib/across-contracts/lib/sp1-contracts/contracts/",":@uniswap/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/@uniswap/",":across-contracts/=lib/across-contracts/contracts/",":arb-bridge-eth/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/arb-bridge-eth/",":arb-bridge-peripherals/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/arb-bridge-peripherals/",":arbos-precompiles/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/arbos-precompiles/",":base64-sol/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/base64-sol/",":ds-test/=lib/murky/lib/openzeppelin-contracts/lib/forge-std/lib/ds-test/src/",":erc4626-tests/=lib/openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable/lib/erc4626-tests/",":eth-gas-reporter/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/eth-gas-reporter/",":forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/",":halmos-cheatcodes/=lib/openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable/lib/halmos-cheatcodes/src/",":hardhat-deploy/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/hardhat-deploy/",":hardhat/=lib/across-contracts/node_modules/hardhat/",":murky/=lib/murky/",":openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable/=lib/openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable/",":open SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1\npragma solidity ^0.8.0;\n\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @notice Mixin exposing a virtual `_safeTransfer` hook. Default implementation uses\n *         OZ `SafeERC20.safeTransfer`. Inheritors may override to swap in alternative\n *         ERC20 transfer semantics.\n */\nabstract contract SafeTransferERC20 {\n    // This mixin is the only place in the codebase permitted to call `IERC20.safeTransfer`\n    // directly. Inheriting contracts restrict their own `using` directives to exclude\n    // `safeTransfer` so all transfer call sites are forced through this overridable hook.\n    using { SafeERC20.safeTransfer } for IERC20;\n\n    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual {\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(to, amount);\n    }\n}\n"},{"file_path":"lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol","source_code":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n// OpenZeppelin Contracts (last updated v5.3.0) (access/AccessControl.sol)\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {IAccessControl} from \"./IAccessControl.sol\";\nimport {Context} from \"../utils/Context.sol\";\nimport {ERC165} from \"../utils/introspection/ERC165.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @dev Contract module that allows children to implement role-based access\n * control mechanisms. Exposed so a\n    ///         committed requirement/planner can authenticate values folded into the salt (e.g. the\n    ///         counterfactual destination salt preimage) without rebuilding the pathId/stepId itself.\n    function currentSalt() external view returns (bytes32 salt_);\n\n    /// @notice Execute a step in one transaction.\n    function execute(Step step, SubmitterInputs calldata submitterInputs, FundingEntry[] calldata funding)\n        external\n        payable;\n}\n"},{"file_path":"src/types/Common.sol","source_code":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\n/// @dev Step is the root of a Merkle tree of possible Paths this order can follow.\ntype Step is bytes32;\n\n/// @dev One of the ways to complete a Step. A Merkle leaf on the Step's root.\n///      `chainId` binds the path to a specific chain — Gateway rejects paths\n///      whose `chainId` does not match `block.chainid`.\nstruct Path {\n    // Chain this path is intended to execute on\n    uint256 chainId;\n    // Used for obfuscation of Merkle leaves\n    bytes32 salt;\n    // Contract to call as bytes32\n    bytes32 executor;\n    // Message for the executor\n    bytes message;\n}\n\n/// @notice A funding entry. `header` stores the FUNDING_* type; see\n///         `FundingCodec.{packHeader,unpackHeader}` and the constants in\n///         `GatewayFunding.sol`. Witness-bound funding always uses the current\n///         stepId.\nstruct FundingEntry {\n    uint256 header;\n    bytes data;\n}\n\nstruct SubmitterInputs {\n    Path path;\n    // Always a Merkle proof — single-path steps use a one-leaf tree with an empty proof.\n    bytes32[] proof;\n    // Note: when interpreting path.message provided by the user, path.executor will sometimes reach into executorMessage\n    // provided here for submitter-provided data. User defines commands + static values, this lets submitter augment\n    // execution with dynamic data (e.g. planner output or DEX swap instructions)\n    bytes executorMessage;\n}\n\n/// @notice Live execution context exposed by Gateway during each execution.\nstruct ExecutionContext {\n    bytes32 stepId;\n    bytes32 pathId;\n    address submitter;\n    bytes32
